pre: The seller registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Click Register.
data:
First Name: Maria Clara
Last Name: Santos
Email: mariaclara.santos@example.com
Mobile Number: 09189876543
Shop Name: Maria Clara Handicrafts
Shop Category: Home & Living
Seller Type: Sole Proprietorship
TIN: 123-456-789-000
Region: National Capital Region (NCR)
Province: Metro Manila
City / Municipality: Quezon City
Barangay: Commonwealth
Street Address: Blk 12 Lot 8, Sampaguita St.
Postal Code: 1121
Government-issued ID (upload): govt_id_front.jpg (1.2 MB)
DTI Certificate (upload): dti_certificate.pdf (850 KB)
BIR Form 2303 (upload): bir_2303.pdf (1.1 MB)
Password: Tindahan@2026
Confirm Password: Tindahan@2026
Terms and Privacy Policy: Ticked
expected: The form is accepted with no validation errors. A success message is shown, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the email, and the email verification page opens. The account is saved with status Unverified.

pre: The seller registration page is open.
steps:
1. Leave every field blank and every dropdown on its default option.
2. Click Register.
data: All fields blank
expected: Registration is blocked. A required-field message is shown for every mandatory field. No account is created and no OTP is sent.

steps:
1. Fill in all fields with valid data.
2. Clear one required field.
3. Click Register.
4. Repeat for each field in the test data.
data:
Clear in turn:
First Name
Last Name
Email
Mobile Number
Shop Name
Shop Category
Seller Type
TIN
Region
Province
City / Municipality
Barangay
Street Address
Postal Code
Government-issued ID (upload)
DTI Certificate (upload)
BIR Form 2303 (upload)
Password
Confirm Password
expected: Each time, registration is blocked and a required-field message is shown on the blank field only. Other entered values (except passwords and uploads) are kept. No account is created.

pre: The seller account mariaclara.santos@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.

pre: The seller account mariaclara.santos@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.

pre: The seller account mariaclara.santos@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.

2. Enter the first code and click Verify.
3. Enter the second code and click Verify.
data: First code (for example 482913), then the second code (for example 907356)
expected: A new OTP email arrives. The first code is rejected. The second code is accepted and the account is verified.

scenario: Admin rejects the application with a reason
pre: A second seller application is Pending Approval (use the Account 2 data). An admin account is logged in.

1. Open the application.
2. Click Reject, type the reason, and confirm.
3. Log in with the seller account.
data: Reason: DTI certificate is blurred and the business name cannot be read.
expected: Status changes to Rejected. The seller receives an email containing the reason. On login, the reason is shown and the seller dashboard is not available.

pre: The seller application from the previous case has status Rejected.
steps:

2. Replace the DTI Certificate (or the rejected document).
3. Click Resubmit.
data: DTI Certificate (or the rejected document): dti_certificate_clear.pdf (1.0 MB)
expected: Status returns to Pending Approval and the application appears again in the admin's pending list with the new document.
